history.summary: 521-unit D19 Hougang leasehold (2011) next to NE13 Kovan MRT, 2BR at $1.77M / $2,000psf. URA shows a strong 7.49% CAGR but asking PSF ($2,000) is well above the $1,872 URA median, and resident reviews flag sub-par build quality requiring constant patching. Priced rich for a 15-year-old leasehold with quality concerns.
history.rating_rationale: The 7.49%/yr URA over 97 transactions is genuinely good and Kovan MRT at 560m supports demand, but you are paying ~7% above URA median ($2,000 vs $1,872psf) for a development reviewers describe as 'full of defects, sub-par quality, constant repairing,' with main-road stacks suffering noise/heat/dirt. The arena score (590) and off-frontier status reflect this rich pricing. The appreciation is attractive but the entry premium and build-quality risk cap it at Neutral.
red_flags: Reviews cite pervasive defects, sub-par build quality, constant repairs
Main-road-facing stacks: noise, heat and dust
Off-frontier, mid arena score (590) — not a value pick at this ask
catalysts: 560m to NE13 Kovan MRT, established Hougang amenities
